verdict.rationale: The only disputes evidence says Airwallex 'will facilitate your dispute management step-by-step' (airwallex-docs-26). It does not document API endpoints for retrieving disputes, attaching evidence, or submitting responses. The AgentOS, MCP and CLI materials list balances, beneficiaries, cards, cashflow and a generic 'broad slice of the API', but never dispute handling, so an end-to-end agent-driven dispute workflow is unevidenced.
